mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff_schedule (admin_id, schedule_date, schedule_type, memo, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{scheduleType}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, admin_id, schedule_date, schedule_type, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM staff_schedule ORDER BY schedule_date, schedule_id
SELECT schedule_id, admin_id, schedule_date, schedule_type, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM staff_schedule WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY schedule_date, schedule_id
SELECT schedule_id, admin_id, schedule_date, schedule_type, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM staff_schedule WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} ORDER BY schedule_id
SELECT schedule_id, admin_id, schedule_date, schedule_type, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM staff_schedule WHERE schedule_type = #{scheduleType} ORDER BY schedule_date, schedule_id
mapper.update: UPDATE staff_schedule SET admin_id = #{adminId}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, schedule_type = #{scheduleType}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
